args.newString:
whitespace = Regex(r"\s")

# Hexadecimal string with optional "0x" prefix, at least one hex digit
hex_str = Regex(r"(?:0x)?[0-9A-Fa-f]+")

# UUID version 4: version digit is "4", variant bits are [89ABab]
uuid4 = Regex(
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}"
    r"-"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{4}"
    r"-4"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{3}"
    r"-[89abAB]"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{3}"
    r"-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}"
)

# IPv4 address with each octet between 0 and 255
ipv4 = Regex(
    r"(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}"
    r"(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|[1-9]?[0-9])"
)
